description: Exploratory user-selected combination, not a proven cumulative baseline: remove eight features (ch_ch_t035_equatorial_area, strip_v450_logmed, rec27, strip_v650_dark, ch_ch_t055_meridian15_area, ace_density_cm3_last, strip_v750_logmed, ace_density_cm3_m6), set offset alpha=1 and spectral Hessian-only. All other original-A settings retained, no B1 blend. Fixed arithmetic mean of fresh seeds 42/43/44; equal 1/3 weights, no fitting to leaderboard labels. Official F1/F2/F3 only; training-only frozen calibration and 144h maturity/purge. Combination selected by user from prior diagnostic scores; no independent holdout claim. Inference time sums measured constituent times plus measured mean computation.
